CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_report (check_name STRING, failing_rows BIGINT);
INSERT INTO workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_report
SELECT 'null_amount' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS failing_rows FROM workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_orders WHERE amount IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'negative_amount', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_orders WHERE amount < 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_order_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_customer', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_orders o LEFT JOIN workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'future_order_date', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_orders WHERE order_date > DATE '2026-11-01'
UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_status', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x64b35.dq_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('new','paid','shipped','cancelled');
